title: 目標達成の後に・邁進！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen has been steadily building up her strength.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As a stayer, her mind is set on winning two particular races in her classic year: the Kikuka Sho and its prelude, the Kobe Shimbun Hai.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She proclaims her desire to keep in good form and remain focused through her progress forward.
